-- Q1: units sold in June 2026 (daily_sales vs pos_lines cross-check)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM store.daily_sales
     WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND date >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND date < DATE '2026-07-01') AS units_daily_sales,
  (SELECT SUM(qty) FROM store.pos_lines
     WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS units_pos_lines,
  (SELECT SUM(line_amount) FROM store.pos_lines
     WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01') AS revenue_pos_lines,
  (SELECT MIN(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS data_start,
  (SELECT MAX(date) FROM store.daily_sales) AS data_end;

-- zero-sale days per SKU, with same-day shelf audit status and book stock
SELECT ds.sku, ds.date, ds.units_sold, ib.book_on_hand_close,
       (SELECT string_agg(sa.status, ',' ORDER BY sa.audit_ts)
          FROM store.shelf_audits sa
         WHERE sa.sku=ds.sku AND sa.audit_ts::date=ds.date) AS audit_status
FROM store.daily_sales ds
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.sku=ds.sku AND ib.date=ds.date
WHERE ds.units_sold=0
ORDER BY ds.sku, ds.date;

-- bills referenced by complaints: do they contain atta?
SELECT c.complaint_ts, c.kind, c.bill_id, c.amount_inr,
       (SELECT string_agg(pl.sku_scanned||'x'||pl.qty, ', ' ORDER BY pl.line)
          FROM store.pos_lines pl WHERE pl.bill_id=c.bill_id) AS lines
FROM payments.customer_complaints c
ORDER BY c.complaint_ts;

-- shopper (bill) counts per day, and consistency of bill_id date vs payment date
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments) AS distinct_bills_paid,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments WHERE ts::date <> to_date('20'||substr(bill_id,2,6),'YYYYMMDD')) AS bills_with_mismatched_date,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines) AS bills_in_pos_lines,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM payments.pos_payments WHERE ts::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28') AS bills_june;

-- zero-sale days and empty audits across all SKUs, to see whether zero sales is normal
SELECT ds.sku,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ds.units_sold=0) AS zero_sale_days,
       COUNT(*) AS days,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store.shelf_audits sa WHERE sa.sku=ds.sku AND sa.status='empty') AS empty_audits,
       (SELECT string_agg(sa.audit_ts::date::text, ',' ORDER BY sa.audit_ts)
          FROM store.shelf_audits sa WHERE sa.sku=ds.sku AND sa.status='empty') AS empty_dates
FROM store.daily_sales ds
GROUP BY ds.sku
ORDER BY ds.sku;

-- Does an 'empty' audit always mean zero sales that day? (check all SKUs)
SELECT sa.audit_ts::date AS d, sa.sku, sa.status,
       ds.units_sold, ib.book_on_hand_close
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
LEFT JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.sku=sa.sku AND ds.date=sa.audit_ts::date
LEFT JOIN store.inventory_book ib ON ib.sku=sa.sku AND ib.date=sa.audit_ts::date
ORDER BY sa.sku, sa.audit_ts;
